body:
severity: error
timestamp: 2026-05-30T21:45:32Z

findings:
secwatch has failed to ingest any filings for BAC, C, GS, JPM, and MS across every poll round today (10+ rounds observed). All 5 fail consistently with the same error: "unexpected end of JSON input" when fetching from EDGAR's submissions endpoint (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK{n}.json).

These are all high-volume filers — each has thousands of filings in their EDGAR history. The root cause is almost certainly EDGAR's submissions pagination: for large filers, EDGAR splits older filings into separate paginated JSON files referenced under a "files" array in the primary submissions response. If secwatch is only reading the primary submissions JSON and not following the pagination links, it will silently truncate the response — or if the primary JSON itself is very large, a fixed read bu

suggested_fix:
In the secwatch EDGAR client (likely internal/secwatch/edgar.go or similar), check how the submissions JSON is fetched and parsed:

1. Check if the response is being read with a fixed buffer — replace with ioutil.ReadAll or equivalent to handle large payloads.
2. After parsing the primary submissions JSON, check for a top-level "files" array. If present, fetch each paginated file from https://data
title: FatBaby obs [error]: EDGAR submissions endpoint returning truncated JSON for all 5 major bank ticker
